User.title: User
User.description: The profile and preferences of a CBSE Class 10 student

learningPace.description: Tailored learning pace calculated by AI or self-selected

weakAreas.description: Topics or chapters where the student scored low

strengthAreas.description: Topics or chapters where the student scored high

dailyStreak.description: Number of consecutive days student has engaged with the app

lastQuizDate.description: ISO date of when the student took their last quiz

selectedSubjects.description: List of subjects targeted by the student

Progress.title: Progress
Progress.description: Continuous progress tracking of a student per subject/chapter level

subjectId.description: Id of the subject (e.g. science, mathematics)

completed.description: Whether the student has completed reading or studying this chapter

quizAttempts.description: Total number of quiz attempts on this chapter

highScore.description: High score out of 100 on quizzes in this chapter

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last completion or progress update

QuizResult.title: QuizResult
QuizResult.description: Detailed log of practice quizzes and timed PYQs (Past Year Questions)

timeTaken.description: Time taken in seconds to complete the timed test

date.description: ISO timestamp indicating when the test was completed

weakTopicsIdentified.description: Specific topics within the test where user answered incorrectly

/users/{userId}/quizzes/{quizId}.description: Completed quiz or timed past year question results
